chapters.title: 水在背上，出口誰管？
rows: 你背著三公升水，若管口一直滴，喝到以前就先漏掉；多裝水，能解決這件事嗎？
Medium shot of an anonymous cyclist holding a plain large hydration bag while watching a droplet at its loose tube end, soft overcast light.
VIEWER_HYPOTHETICAL_WITH_SOURCED_CAPACITY
八〇年代末，德州一場單車賽裡，品牌回顧中的艾德森，把一袋水放到車衣背後。
Medium shot of an anonymous cyclist positioning a plain sock-covered water pouch at the rear of a cycling jersey, overcast light.
ATTRIBUTED_RETROSPECTIVE_WITH_DATE_RANGE
袋子外面套著襪子，管子越過肩膀；我注意到的，卻是管口那枚衣夾。
Close-up of an anonymous cyclist studying a wooden clothespin clamped on the end of a plain shoulder tube, soft side light.
AUTHOR_REACTION_TO_SOURCED_OBJECT
後來，出口被送進模具，也被夾在模擬牙齒的金屬之間。
Close-up of a plain flexible drinking mouthpiece resting beside an empty small mold and two metal test plates, diffuse workshop light.
TWO_OBJECT_TEASERS
今天跟著CamelBak的一袋水，從背上身，走到下一次還能再喝。
Medium shot of an anonymous adult lifting a plain hydration pack from a bench, soft window light.
NAMED_SCOPE_PROMISE
把水背上身之後，怎麼讓它在你要喝時出來，其他時候留在該在的地方？
Close-up of an anonymous adult looking curiously at the end of a plain drinking tube, neutral indoor light.
CENTRAL_QUESTION

chapters.title: 衣夾守住的出口，換成回閉的狹縫
rows: 那枚衣夾先替管端守住出口；紐西蘭品牌回顧說，艾德森就是用它夾住管子。
Close-up of a plain wooden clothespin compressing a flexible drinking tube end beside an anonymous hand, soft daylight.
ATTRIBUTED_ACTION_RESULT
他是急救醫療技術員，回顧裡那袋水，用的原是點滴袋；襪子套在袋外，水仍裝在袋裡。
Medium shot of an anonymous cyclist holding a plain sock-covered flexible pouch, with only the upper pouch edge visible, diffuse light.
ATTRIBUTED_RETROSPECTIVE
你看這個安排，背後負責帶水，管子負責把水送到肩上；襪子自己並不裝水。
Medium shot of an anonymous cyclist pointing toward a plain tube crossing one shoulder from a sock-covered pouch, mild overcast light.
NARROW_PHYSICAL_INTERPRETATION
但把出口移到嘴邊，和讓出口自己關上，是同一件事嗎？
Close-up of an anonymous cyclist glancing from a plain tube end to its separate wooden clothespin, diffuse light.
FORWARD_CONTROL_QUESTION
這套拼裝留下的，是手動夾閉：衣夾還要有人照顧，並不會因為你喝完，就自己回到管口。
Close-up of an anonymous hand holding a detached wooden clothespin beside a plain flexible tube end, soft side light.
NARROW_PHYSICAL_RESULT
我覺得，管子越過肩膀的意義，也在這裡：水已經來到嘴邊，控制水的機會也到了嘴邊。
Medium shot of an anonymous cyclist looking thoughtfully at a plain shoulder tube near the mouth, overcast light.
AUTHOR_REACTION
如果放開嘴，出口就能關回去，你的手是不是能少管一件事？
Close-up of an anonymous adult studying a plain flexible drinking mouthpiece beside an older separate clamp, soft desk light.
FORWARD_SELF_CLOSURE_QUESTION

chapters.title: 衣夾守住的出口，換成回閉的狹縫
rows: 後來的咬閥，把這個開關問題交給了嘴；其中一份口器專利，記下可變形的出口。
Close-up of an anonymous hand holding a plain elastic drinking mouthpiece beside a blank technical sheet, soft lamp light.
DOCUMENTED_DESIGN_INTRODUCTION
這份申請在一九九八年提出，二〇〇〇年獲准；它描述的出口，不是一個始終敞開的圓孔。
Close-up conceptual view of a plain flexible mouthpiece with a closed narrow slit, blank paper underneath, neutral light.
DATED_PATENT_DESIGN
前端兩片相貼的部分，合起一條平常閉著的狹縫；水路已經接上，縫卻還沒打開。
A10,A_MOUTH_P7
Close-up conceptual view of a plain elastic mouthpiece with two touching lips forming a closed slit, soft side light.
DOCUMENTED_CLOSED_STATE
你若只想到把孔挖大，就漏掉了這個問題：不喝的時候，那個孔由誰補回去？
Medium shot of an anonymous adult comparing an open tube end with a closed flexible mouthpiece, diffuse indoor light.
VIEWER_MECHANISM_QUESTION
專利裡，牙齒壓住可咬的區域，口器變形，貼在一起的兩片才分開，形成出水口。
A10,A_MOUTH_P8
Close-up conceptual view of a plain flexible mouthpiece gently compressed at opposite sides, showing its slit opening, neutral light.
DOCUMENTED_ACTION_RESULT
力氣撤掉以後，彈性讓它回到閉合狀態；開和關，靠的是同一個零件的形變。
A11,A_MOUTH_P8
Close-up conceptual view of a plain flexible mouthpiece returning to a closed slit after release, soft side light.
DOCUMENTED_RETURN_RESULT
我喜歡這個轉換：原先掛在外面的衣夾，換成出口本身會回復的形狀。
Medium shot of an anonymous adult studying a plain self-closing mouthpiece with a separate wooden clamp resting nearby, soft window light.
AUTHOR_COMPARISON_NOT_SAME_PART
可是，材料軟到能咬，為什麼不會放開以後，就一直扁在那裡？
Close-up of an anonymous hand lightly pressing the side of a plain soft mouthpiece, diffuse workshop light.
FORWARD_MATERIAL_QUESTION
文件選材看的是能不能回到閉合狀態，並舉一種硬度的矽膠作例子；軟，還得能回彈。
Close-up of an anonymous hand releasing a plain elastic silicone mouthpiece on a workbench, soft lamp light.
DOCUMENTED_MATERIAL_REQUIREMENT
口器的脖子接著管端，頭部留給嘴含住；那個整天碰到嘴的地方，怎麼清理？
A_MOUTH_P7
Close-up conceptual view of a plain mouthpiece neck aligned with a flexible tube end, soft side light.
DOCUMENTED_CONNECTION_DESIGN
專利說，口器能從管子上滑下來，再裝回去，方便清潔與維護。
A_MOUTH_P7
Close-up of anonymous hands separating a plain removable mouthpiece from a flexible drinking tube, neutral indoor light.
DOCUMENTED_DETACHABLE_CONNECTION
你嘴邊的小零件，已經不只是讓水通過；它還得有一個能被取下、重新接好的位置。
A_MOUTH_P7
Medium shot of an anonymous adult looking at a separated plain mouthpiece and its tube connector on a bench, diffuse light.
VIEWER_PHYSICAL_INTERPRETATION
文件裡還記了一組出水測試；咬開這條縫，水究竟能怎樣通過？
A_MOUTH_P8
Medium shot of an anonymous tester holding a plain drinking tube and mouthpiece near the mouth, soft indoor light.
FORWARD_FLOW_TEST_QUESTION
用的是圖一到圖十那種口器，放進嘴裡、咬到出水狀態，再像吸管那樣吸水。
A_MOUTH_P8
Medium shot of an anonymous adult drawing water through a plain tube mouthpiece from an unmarked flexible bag, soft window light.
APPLICANT_REPORTED_TEST_CONDITION
報出的流量是每秒約三十五到四十五毫升；數字裡，也包含人在吸的動作。
A_MOUTH_P8
Close-up of a plain tube mouthpiece and an unmarked measuring vessel beside an anonymous test hand, diffuse laboratory light.
APPLICANT_REPORTED_TEST_RESULT
我讀這段時，最在意的是水路終於有了可觀察的結果：嘴一邊開口，一邊把水吸過來。
A_MOUTH_P8
Medium shot of an anonymous tester looking toward a plain mouthpiece and water vessel on a bench, soft side light.
AUTHOR_REACTION_TO_LIMITED_TEST
這是那個設計記載的測試，還不是每一款袋子、每一個嘴，都會流出同樣的量。
A_MOUTH_P8
Close-up of an anonymous hand setting one plain tested mouthpiece apart from other blank component samples, neutral light.
TEST_SCOPE_BOUNDARY
可既然控制已經在嘴邊，水還非得背在背後嗎？
Medium shot of an anonymous adult looking from a plain hydration pack toward a plain hand-held bottle, soft daylight.
FORWARD_CONTAINER_QUESTION

chapters.title: 出口搬到手握瓶
rows: 二〇〇六年的展場報導裡，那個咬著喝的出口，已經搬到透明水瓶上。
Medium shot at a simple exhibition counter, an anonymous adult holding a plain clear bottle with a raised drinking spout, diffuse indoor light.
DATED_REPORTER_OBSERVATION
記者寫的是七百五十毫升瓶，咬口可以翻起，下面接著瓶內一小段吸管。
Close-up of an anonymous hand holding a plain clear bottle with a flip-up mouthpiece and a short visible internal straw, soft side light.
REPORTED_PHYSICAL_CONFIGURATION
你手裡換回瓶子，嘴邊卻不用換回一個敞開的瓶口；這才是讓我停下來看的地方。
Medium shot of an anonymous adult looking with curiosity at a raised flexible mouthpiece on a plain bottle, soft window light.
AUTHOR_VIEWER_REACTION
原先是管子越肩來找嘴，現在瓶子被手拿起，短管把瓶裡的水接到上面的咬口。
Close-up of an anonymous hand lifting a plain clear bottle, its short internal tube leading toward the mouthpiece, neutral light.
NARROW_CONTAINER_COMPARISON
容器變了，讓出口在喝的時候打開，這個工作能一起搬過去嗎？
Medium shot of an anonymous adult examining the mouthpiece on a plain clear bottle, diffuse daylight.
FORWARD_TRANSFER_QUESTION
同年公開的一份水瓶申請文件，描述了受壓變形的咬口，也引用先前那份口器專利。
Close-up of an anonymous hand studying a blank bottle diagram beside a separate flexible mouthpiece, soft desk light.
DOCUMENT_TO_DOCUMENT_CONNECTION
裡面的構想仍是壓開、撤力回閉；換容器，不必連開關的原理都從頭換掉。
Close-up conceptual view of a plain flexible bottle mouthpiece with a narrow closed slit, neutral workshop light.
DOCUMENTED_DESIGN_CONTINUITY
可是，報導說它防漏，是記者測過，還是公司這樣說？
Medium shot of an anonymous adult examining one plain exhibition bottle while blank alternative sketches rest separately nearby, soft light.
FORWARD_REPORTED_PERFORMANCE_QUESTION
防漏，是公司在報導裡的說法；這個展品，讓出口和容器的分工，出現在日常水瓶裡。
Close-up of an anonymous hand holding a plain bottle upright with its mouthpiece folded down, diffuse indoor light.
ATTRIBUTED_COMPANY_CLAIM_AND_OBSERVATION
我覺得，這次不是背水的點子被丟掉，而是把能帶走的控制，留在另一種容器上。
Medium shot of an anonymous adult placing a plain bottle beside an open plain hydration pack, soft window light.
AUTHOR_INTERPRETATION
不過，瓶子拿起一次能喝，和袋子在身上反覆擠、反覆咬，能算同一場考驗嗎？
Medium shot of an anonymous tester watching a plain flexible reservoir on a workbench, diffuse workshop light.
FORWARD_REPEATED_USE_QUESTION

chapters.title: 袋子被扭，嘴被反覆夾壓
rows: 背袋會受擠壓，水路也分成不同部件；二〇一四年年報，寫下當時的組合。
Medium shot of an anonymous technician arranging a plain flexible reservoir, tube and separate mouthpiece on a workbench, soft light.
DATED_PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION
那是聚氨酯袋體、管子，再接自封口器；同份年報的採購段，也列出聚氨酯膜。
Close-up of an anonymous hand holding a plain flexible reservoir beside a roll of blank film and a separate tube, diffuse workshop light.
DATED_MATERIAL_DESCRIPTION
你背著它走時，會彎動的是袋子，嘴邊一再受壓的，卻是另一個小部件。
Medium shot of an anonymous walker holding a plain flexible reservoir with a drinking tube at one shoulder, soft overcast light.
PHYSICAL_COMPONENT_INTERPRETATION
所以，要看反覆使用，該把力氣加在哪裡？
Close-up of an anonymous technician positioning a plain reservoir beside a separate mouthpiece test fixture, soft side light.
FORWARD_TEST_ACTION_QUESTION
二〇一五年，記者走進加州佩塔盧馬的實驗室，看見水袋正在被壓、被扭。
Medium shot in a simple laboratory, an anonymous technician observing a plain reservoir being pressed and twisted in a fixture, diffuse light.
DATED_REPORTER_SITE_OBSERVATION
同時，十二個咬閥夾在兩片金屬之間，模擬大人和孩子的牙齒反覆咬壓。
Wide conceptual view of twelve plain small mouthpieces arranged between two metal test plates, soft laboratory light.
REPORTED_TEST_ACTION
開場那副金屬牙齒，到這裡有了工作：不只碰一下出口，而是反覆讓它受力。
Close-up of plain metal test plates pressing a row of flexible mouthpieces, diffuse side light.
NAMED_TEASER_PAYOFF
我覺得這個畫面比一句耐用有用得多；袋子和咬口，承受的動作根本不同。
Medium shot of an anonymous technician looking between a reservoir fixture and a mouthpiece fixture, soft indoor light.
AUTHOR_REACTION
你可能會追問：夾了多少次、多久壞，最後有幾個通過？
Close-up of an anonymous adult looking at a blank results sheet beside a plain mouthpiece test fixture, soft lamp light.
OBSERVATION_RESULT_LIMIT
這篇報導沒有交出那張成績表，留下的，是袋體與嘴部分別被施力的現場。
Medium shot of an anonymous technician removing one plain mouthpiece from a metal fixture, diffuse light.
TEST_SCOPE_BOUNDARY
而出口要被咬，前提是手裡真有一個能變形的樣件；螢幕上的形狀，怎麼交給嘴試？
Medium shot of an anonymous engineer studying a blank computer screen beside an empty small mold, soft desk light.
FORWARD_PHYSICAL_PROTOTYPE_QUESTION

chapters.title: 模具裡出來的是能試的矽膠件
rows: 二〇一六年的供應商個案，訪問了設計工程師麥克里迪；他做的是一體、自封的矽膠咬閥樣件。
Medium shot of an anonymous engineer holding a plain one-piece flexible mouthpiece at a workbench, soft window light.
DATED_NAMED_ENGINEER_RETROSPECTIVE
他先做出三維列印模具，再用模具做真正的矽膠零件；列印的，不是拿來咬的塑膠替身。
Close-up of an anonymous hand lifting a plain flexible silicone part from a small printed mold, diffuse workshop light.
ATTRIBUTED_MANUFACTURING_ACTION
如果要知道放開會不會回閉，你拿一塊硬的外形模型，能替軟零件回答嗎？
Medium shot of an anonymous engineer comparing a rigid blank model with a flexible mouthpiece sample, soft side light.
VIEWER_PHYSICAL_PROTOTYPE_QUESTION
這次交到手裡的是可拿去測的矽膠件，形狀與材料，才有機會一起接受人的測試。
Close-up of an anonymous engineer lightly flexing a plain silicone mouthpiece sample, soft lamp light.
ATTRIBUTED_PROTOTYPE_RESULT
工程師回述，這樣兩天就拿到了測試零件；那個數字買到的是能試，不是已經證明不壞。
Medium shot of an anonymous engineer placing a plain silicone sample beside its small mold on a bench, diffuse daylight.
ATTRIBUTED_TWO_DAY_RESULT_WITH_SCOPE
我喜歡這個結果，因為下一個判斷不用只對著螢幕做；手裡已經有東西，能交給真的人。
Medium shot of an anonymous tester receiving a plain flexible mouthpiece sample on a clean tray, soft indoor light.
AUTHOR_REACTION
拿到軟樣件以後，工程師最想再取得什麼？
A18,A19,A_SW_CONTEXT
Medium shot of an anonymous engineer listening attentively beside a plain prototype tray and a blank notebook, diffuse light.
FORWARD_USER_FEEDBACK_QUESTION
他說，越能從真人測試取得回饋越好；能被人試的出口，才有機會把感受帶回設計。
A18,A19,A_SW_CONTEXT
Close-up of an anonymous hand holding a plain silicone mouthpiece above its empty mold, soft side light.
ATTRIBUTED_USER_FEEDBACK_PURPOSE
可是，就算嘴邊會自封，補水時還有另一個開口必須打開；那裡也能守住水嗎？
Medium shot of an anonymous adult holding a plain reservoir by its filling handle beside a sink, soft window light.
FORWARD_REFILL_SEAL_QUESTION

chapters.title: 嘴關好了，蓋邊還有一條縫
rows: 補水口把你帶回袋子上；開場那款水袋的現行介紹，特別列了方便握住、重新灌水的把手。
Medium shot of an anonymous adult gripping a plain reservoir filling handle beside a tap, diffuse daylight.
CURRENT_PRODUCT_FEATURE
這一款還有單手開關，可以關住飲水管；嘴邊的自封口器，另負責每次喝完後的回閉。
Close-up of an anonymous hand touching the simple shutoff lever beside a plain reservoir drinking tube, soft side light.
CURRENT_PRODUCT_DISTINCT_CONTROLS
我原先容易把不漏水，全想成嘴邊那一小塊；可是補水蓋，也是一個得關好的接面。
Medium shot of an anonymous adult looking from a plain mouthpiece toward the large reservoir cap, soft indoor light.
AUTHOR_REACTION
如果出口沒有滴，水卻從蓋邊跑出來，你會先看哪裡？
Close-up of an anonymous hand examining a plain reservoir filling cap with a small droplet near its rim, diffuse light.
FORWARD_CAP_LEAK_QUESTION
原廠現行問答列出兩個可能原因：蓋子螺紋有砂粒，或者蓋內的密封圈扭了。
Close-up conceptual view of a plain reservoir cap beside a few fine grains and a separate twisted sealing ring, neutral light.
OFFICIAL_POSSIBLE_FAILURE_CAUSES
砂粒讓蓋子不能完整密合；那個黑色環若扭曲變形，也會破壞蓋口的密封。
A22,A_CARE_CONTEXT
Close-up of an anonymous hand inspecting fine grit caught in plain cap threads, soft desk light.
OFFICIAL_FAILURE_MECHANISM
所以你手上看似已經轉緊的蓋子，裡面仍可能有一個地方，沒有貼好。
A22,A_CARE_CONTEXT
Medium shot of an anonymous adult studying the underside of a plain reservoir cap, diffuse daylight.
VIEWER_PHYSICAL_INTERPRETATION
能不能在背出去以前，讓這條縫先露出來？
Medium shot of an anonymous adult lifting a plain filled reservoir above a sink, soft window light.
FORWARD_LEAK_CHECK_QUESTION
原廠的季前檢查，把水裝回袋子，蓋好後轉動、擠壓，觀察有沒有漏水。
Medium shot of an anonymous adult gently turning a plain filled reservoir over a sink to inspect its cap, diffuse light.
ATTRIBUTED_CURRENT_INSPECTION_ACTION
這個動作讓蓋口也承受水與擠壓；觀察的位置，從嘴邊移到了整個裝水的袋子。
Close-up of an anonymous hand pressing a plain filled reservoir while watching its cap rim above a sink, soft side light.
NARROW_INSPECTION_INTERPRETATION
我覺得，它沒有離開一開始的問題：讓水跟你走，還得知道它有沒有從別的地方先走掉。
Medium shot of an anonymous adult looking thoughtfully at a plain reservoir and its cap beside a sink, diffuse light.
AUTHOR_REACTION
可喝完、洗完之後，水反而不該再留在袋裡；這次要怎麼讓它出去？
Close-up of an anonymous hand holding an empty plain reservoir with a few droplets in its corners, soft window light.
FORWARD_DRYING_QUESTION

chapters.title: 最後一點水，得離開角落
rows: 洗後殘水，把水路反過來考了一次；原廠清潔頁說，角落、飲水管和咬口都可能留水。
Close-up of an anonymous hand inspecting a plain reservoir corner beside its detached tube and mouthpiece, soft indoor light.
OFFICIAL_RESIDUAL_WATER_LOCATIONS
你看到外面已經乾了，不表示管內和接縫，也一起乾了。
Medium shot of an anonymous adult looking through a plain clear tube for remaining droplets, diffuse daylight.
VIEWER_RESIDUAL_WATER_QUESTION
我覺得這是整段水路最刁鑽的反面：喝的時候要留住水，收起來以前，卻要把殘水送走。
Medium shot of an anonymous adult watching a droplet cling inside a plain empty reservoir, soft window light.
AUTHOR_REACTION
原廠的清洗範圍，因此不只是一個大袋子；水走過的管與咬口，也得接到清水。
A25,A_CLEAN_CONTEXT
Close-up of an anonymous hand rinsing a plain flexible drinking tube above a sink, diffuse daylight.
OFFICIAL_COMPLETE_WATER_PATH_CLEANING
但洗掉殘留物以後，內壁還貼在一起，空氣要從哪裡進去？
Close-up of an anonymous hand holding a flattened plain empty reservoir with its inner walls touching, soft side light.
FORWARD_INNER_WALL_QUESTION
清潔頁給的動作，是把袋體撐開，讓內部通風；乾燥架把兩邊內壁分開，也讓水能排出。
Medium shot of an anonymous adult positioning a plain open reservoir on a simple drying support, soft window light.
OFFICIAL_DRYING_ACTION_RESULT
出口能回閉，這時卻不能替內部乾燥；袋口得打開，貼合的內壁得分開。
Close-up of a plain reservoir held open on a simple drying support beside a separate closed mouthpiece, diffuse indoor light.
PHYSICAL_FUNCTION_CONTRAST
飲水管若緊緊盤起來，原廠說水會積在低處；怎麼讓管內也有乾燥的路？
A_CLEAN_TUBE
Close-up of an anonymous hand examining a plain clear tube loosely curved above a sink, soft side light.
FORWARD_TUBE_DRYING_QUESTION
它排掉管裡的水，垂直掛起，並讓兩端敞開；乾燥不只留給袋子的內部。
A_CLEAN_TUBE
Medium shot of an anonymous adult hanging a plain drinking tube vertically with both ends open, diffuse window light.
OFFICIAL_TUBE_DRYING_ACTION
分件晾乾用到的是可拆零件；管與咬口各自留出的空間，也讓你能查看裡面是不是還有水。
A_CLEAN_CONTEXT
Close-up of an anonymous hand arranging detachable plain reservoir parts on a drying rack, neutral light.
VIEWER_INTERPRETATION_WITH_DETACHABLE_SCOPE
再看一眼，才知道能不能收回去；原廠要你看的是什麼？
Medium shot of an anonymous adult examining a plain reservoir and hanging tube near an open storage bag, soft daylight.
FORWARD_STORAGE_CHECK_QUESTION
原廠要求收存前再看接縫、角落、管子和接口，有沒有水滴或凝結；還有水，就繼續晾乾。
Close-up of an anonymous adult inspecting a plain reservoir seam for a remaining droplet, soft side light.
OFFICIAL_OBSERVABLE_STORAGE_CRITERION
開場問水能不能留在該在的地方，到這裡，答案多了一個時間點：收起來時，它得離開。
Medium shot of an anonymous adult setting fully aired plain reservoir parts beside an open storage bag, diffuse window light.
CENTRAL_QUESTION_NEW_PHASE_PAYOFF
我想，讓你下一次還能拿起這袋水的方便，就藏在這個沒有水的結尾裡。
Medium shot of an anonymous adult holding an empty plain hydration pack ready for storage, soft indoor light.
AUTHOR_CLOSING_INTERPRETATION
